intro.heading: AUV Electrical Engineering
intro.summary: Custom multi-layer PCB designs, embedded STM32 firmware, and subsea power architecture.

details.subteamMembers: Left to right: Gabe Piano, Seth Richard, Sachin Kumar, Maggie Wu, James Williamson, Rhea Deshpande, Yatin Gour, Aras Jahangiri, Kyle Lee, Jovan Sohi, Malachy Frey, Adam Teodosio, David Manhart, Hasan Mohammad. Not pictured: Salman Amin, Saim Hajini, Antoine Godin, Reid Pratley.

modules.title: Main MCU
modules.desc: The onboard control system was redesigned by replacing the previous ESP32 with an STM32F7 standalone microcontroller. The high-performance ARM Cortex-M7 core provides hardware floating point processing, abundant DMA streams, and dedicated timers for real-time sensor polling and thruster PWM allocation.

modules.title: Actuator Board
modules.desc: The Actuator Board controls all the servos on board the submarine. It allows each servo to be controlled independently and provides optical isolation to prevent electrical interference from high-current thrusters and solenoid surges from feeding back into sensitive microcontrollers.

modules.title: Power Distribution Board (PDB)
modules.desc: Engineered to deliver clean regulated voltages (16V, 12V, 5V, 3.3V) across high-draw subsea brushless thrusters, compute modules, and acoustic electronics. Built with integrated current/voltage sensing for real-time telemetry.

modules.title: Magnetic Kill Switch
modules.desc: A competition-mandated fail-safe that cuts primary battery power cleanly. Designed with a robust magnetic reed / hall latch mechanism completely sealed inside our waterproof enclosure.

modules.title: Battery Management System (BMS)
modules.desc: Custom multi-cell monitoring circuitry providing active cell balancing, over-current cutoffs, under-voltage protection, and precision thermal sensors attached directly to high-capacity LiPo packs.

modules.title: Acoustic Hydrophone Pinger
modules.desc: High-frequency subsea acoustic receivers paired with precision analog front-end bandpass filtering and preamplifiers to localize underwater acoustic beacons via microsecond-level Time Difference of Arrival (TDoA).
